**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The user is planning to build a sustainable home on their new property.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is interested in exploring eco-friendly building materials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant congratulated the user on their decision to build a sustainable home.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended reclaimed or recycled wood, sustainable sourced wood, bamboo, low-carbon concrete, insulated concrete forms (ICFs), straw bales, earthbags, recycled plastics, natural fibers, living roofs, cork, rammed earth, low-VOC paints, sustainable insulation, and repurposed materials as eco-friendly building materials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised the user to consider factors like durability, maintenance, and local availability when selecting eco-friendly building materials.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested consulting with architects, builders, and suppliers to ensure that chosen materials align with the project's specific needs and regulations.
- [TEMPORAL] The session date is 2023/04/10 (Mon) at 20:22.
- [FACT] The user inquired about the typical ROI on solar panels and certifications to look for when selecting a solar panel company.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided information on the typical ROI on solar panels, stating it averages around 8-12% per year.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned that the ROI can vary based on location, system size and quality, installation cost, incentives, and system lifespan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided rough estimates of ROI based on system size: small system (2-3 kW): 8-10% ROI, medium system (5-7 kW): 10-12% ROI, large system (10-15 kW): 12-15% ROI.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant listed certifications to look for in a solar panel company: NABCEP Certification, UL Certification, ISO 9001 Certification, OSEI Certification, SEIA Membership, local licenses and permits, and insurance and bonding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised researching customer reviews, experience with similar projects, warranty and maintenance offerings, transparency about system performance, and compliance with local building codes when evaluating solar panel companies.
